title: Restore owner-221 stock before the original chart-635 cutoff
body:
## Result

Retargeted 3409 arrives at chart 0 at instruction **10396**, immediately after 2947. Its actual row XOR the already-local x17 equals the exact original packet-3410 row. The old feedback is therefore available from those two fields before the original 19903 send. Readers perform the local XOR; this time measures available stock. Delaying terminal-only packets 3388 and 3406 until after 3408 keeps owner 221’s four exact chart-635 receipts ready at 10118, 10142, 10154 and **19906**, one instruction before the original final receipt at **19907**. Old 3407 now sends at 19902. Owners 221, 411, and 679 are correct in both full 680-row orientations. The unchanged native paid grade histogram is checked for both orientations. Retimed word gzip SHA-256 `ed8ac73a77bbe4545e1dc49830c98824f2d4a0dfab876f5b42723cd7980cf760`.

## Caller obstruction and price

The pinned paired caller rejects the moved owner-17 head. All 111 existing body reassignments fail: the moved head has dimension zero, the bodies have rank seven, and the required contact has rank eight. The original head/body pair supplies the positive control. Even granting the 36-fold hypothetical native target credit leaves BIT margin about −0.07064423157 at κ = 0.00388. The separate unchanged rational margin is +0.13897452233. A compatible and fully priced outer binding and owned erasure remain open. No new κ is asserted.

## Replay

Current archive SHA-256 `a3d19e0d3c14fa4ad64ea4d762edaec021301133aebce359e18f5ea4ef883291`. A fresh extraction passed `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`, `python3 -I -B verify_early_feedback.py`, `python3 -I -B verify_clock.py`, and `python3 -I -B verify_owner17.py`. An independent raw-field trace checked both live chart-0 operands at 10396, every owner-221 arrival and its lifetime, and the later output swap. The initial head `9a1f6c33ff7ec0383e726c4bc95e7b7276048b23` used the late-feedback ordering; its positive deadline control remains in the archive.

## Prior work and open next questions

#8017 `6e090c180ad5c8c9a3ed50e94737fd2be04adf54` supplies the full native rebind. #8019 `1cfbd53554154a3bb0b18b8ee607bb6c8ceaa37d` and #8021 `0a693d83e85eda96a863d1ea262f4f733f01abc0` study separate fixed-endpoint repairs. To qualify this construction, supply one independent and paid dimension for the main port, then rebind the complete outer invoice and finite application to the exact timed word.
